ambiguity: You asked for CSV text but never said which dialect the consumer needs: the separator, the line ending, or when fields are quoted.

facts.fact: The consumer is an ERP import that needs semicolons as the separator, not commas. The comma parsing in src/import.js is for a different feed.
Every field must be quoted, even when it contains no separator.
A header row is fine either way, we do not mind.

stonewall: No strong view on that one - use your judgement.
